{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in flipper_length_mm
missing_flipper = penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()
print("Missing values in flipper_length_mm:", missing_flipper)

# Total number of rows
total_rows = len(penguins)
print("Total rows:", total_rows)

# Proportion of missing data
missing_proportion = missing_flipper / total_rows
print("Missing proportion:", missing_proportion)

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the full series
print("Mean flipper length by species:")
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Identify the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Print final result
print(f"Species with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}")"}
